body: Adopt two non-breaking @adlc 1.13.0 CLI enhancements: (1) in lib/scheduler.mjs (`runConsensusFix`), append `--require-rails` alongside `--rails` whenever `rails.length > 0` so consensus-fix enforces non-empty rail protection at the CLI boundary; (2) in lib/preflight.mjs (`applyMergeForecast`), include `signalsEvaluated: Array.isArray(parsed.signalsEvaluated) ? parsed.signalsEvaluated : []` in the returned summary object from `adlc merge-forecast --json`. Update test/fixtures/fake-adlc to accept `--require-rails` in `consensus-fix` and emit `signalsEvaluated` in `merge-forecast --json`, add unit tests in test/scheduler-consensus-fix.test.mjs and test/plan-merge-forecast.test.mjs, and run `npm run build` to refresh dist/**. Acceptance: `npm run build && npm test` green.
title: Adopt @adlc 1.13.0 consensus-fix --require-rails and merge-forecast signalsEvaluated
